classification: pre-registered full-cost and rolling-year validation of the R373 hold-30 region; research-only
hypothesis: The seven hold-30 cells selected by R373 remain a contiguous no-leverage platform after 3x execution costs and rolling one-year checks, and the centre of that region is preferable to the highest-annual cell.
decision_rules: Use the existing R371/R373 curves for 2x; do not retune the B sleeve.
Run every pre-registered platform cell at 3x, not only the centre.
Use 5x only as a diagnostic for the selected centre and never as a hard rejection.
A cell is accepted only if 2x and 3x point checks pass and at least three of four rolling one-year windows are positive.
The platform passes only if every pre-registered cell passes; the selected cell is the pre-registered centre, never the highest-annual cell.
No leverage, orders, paper targets or production changes are permitted.
known_limits: The platform cells are a post-hoc R373 subset of the R371 grid, not independent discoveries.
Rolling windows overlap and the 2022 start is partial.
Current HS300 membership and current industry snapshot remain non-point-in-time inputs.
Curve-only validation cannot establish trade-level concentration or capacity.
